execution.description: Built Graphite's level planner as a closed Planner task and ran scripted sessions for battery and a synthetic second Challenge, eleven rejection cases, the runner's refusals and six mutation checks, with the existing Graphite and pipeline suites.

expected: Every level 0-5 gets a PROPOSED proposal that passes proposals.validate; a reply outside the rules is rejected and recorded; nothing reaches the repository, the contract or an expansion record.
observed: All pass after one fix: the live runner's refusals print through phase2's RunnerRefused, a SystemExit that prints its own JSON, so the runner returns after it rather than printing a second line. Computed from battery's contract and map, the Level 0 difference has rebuildable capabilities labelled 1, 2 and 5, objective.loss_expressions among the excluded, and Level 3 empty, as OWNER-CHALLENGE-ROADMAP-03 states. The difference can be checked mechanically from ids, so Carbon checks it rather than writes it.
keep: Graphite writes the proposal text; Carbon checks it against facts computed from the contract and the map.
Every source must resolve to the brief, so a proposal cannot cite research that was not given to it.
change: When a live level-planning session is authorized, give the brief the method cards that bear on each level; the fixture index has three synthetic cards.
